blocks.text: • 2 forms, Focused Attack and Single Attack. Support Attacks can be used.
• ALL Attack Weapons damage every machine in the target unit.
• MAP Weapons damage every unit in their attack area.
• Damages up to 5 machines when the targets are adjacent to each other.
• The main pilot needs the Special Skill "Continuous Attack".
• 2 adjacent Twin Units attack an enemy unit with all 4 machines at once.
• Needs Will 140 or more and a support weapon {i:f}.
• The attackers' main pilots need the Special Skill "MB Activate".
